question: Are Every.org 'giving credit' balances donor-advised funds under IRC 4966(d)(2), given that since 2026-09 Every.org accepts IRA QCDs to fund those balances (QCDs to DAFs are excluded by 408(d)(8)(B)(ii))? Use statute, Notice 2017-73, the 2023 proposed DAF regulations and Every.org's first Form 990 Schedule D (CY2025) once filed
conclusion_affected: Classification of donation-platform intermediaries; QCD eligibility; Every.org DAF scale
rationale: Every.org was a PF in a 507(b)(1)(B) termination for 2020-24 and is now a 170(b)(1)(A)(vi) charity (Letter 4422, 2025-10-23). Its help centre calls balances a 'DAF structure', its audit books them as customer deposits, and its QCD article says an IRA gift 'can be used to fund your account balance'. The three 4966(d)(2) prongs look met on the face of it [I]
